name: Dante
source:
A Hero who was exiled to Australia, who speaks in a poetic way.

Hallowed be her name in Heaven, Sanctified be her name in Hell.

"Will ye not filter the dregs that pollute your soul?"

From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
